goal: Bootstrap the project, configure tooling, define the database schema, and set up authentication and i18n.
summary: Phase 1 completed. Foundation in place: Next.js 14.2.35 + TypeScript + Tailwind 3.4.17 + shadcn/ui, Prisma 6.19.3 with SQLite schema and seed, NextAuth v4 credentials auth, next-intl en/zh-Hant routing, and shared locale layout with nav/footer/language switcher. Build, lint, and seed all pass.
stepSummaries:
1. Initialize Next.js 14+ with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, ESLint, App Router; install shadcn/ui and base components. Creates package.json, app/, components/ui/, lib/, prisma/. [verified]
  2. Configure Prisma with SQLite and define schema for User, Course, Booking, BlogPost, SiteContent, Payment, and Availability. Creates prisma/schema.prisma and a seed script. [verified]
  3. Configure NextAuth.js/Auth.js credentials provider for admin login; add admin seed script at scripts/seed.ts. Creates app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts. [verified]
  4. Configure next-intl with messages/en.json and messages/zh-Hant.json; set up middleware.ts and locale routing. Creates i18n config files. [verified]
  5. Add shared layout with navigation shell, footer, and language switcher. Creates app/[locale]/layout.tsx and components/layout/. [verified]
evidence: All 5 steps completed. Build passes; lint now runs `eslint app components lib prisma middleware.ts i18n.config.ts --ext .ts,.tsx` and exits 0; Prisma migration applied; seed creates admin + sample course; NextAuth route registered; middleware combines locale routing and admin gate.
